in_hebrew.name: Fuller
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Fulfiller, completeness, satisfaction
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fuller הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'plērōs', meaning 'full' or 'complete'. This name carries the symbolism of fulfilling one's purpose, achieving completeness, and finding satisfaction in life.

This name carries the symbolism of fulfilling one's purpose, achieving completeness, and finding satisfaction in life.
